_meta.description: A walking adventure through five camps: puzzles to solve, decisions to make and a campfire at the end of each day, with a very good dog as your guide. Free, in nine languages, nothing to install.
_og.alt: A dotted trail climbing past four lit camps to a flagged summit under a full moon, with a white dog waiting on the path.
_og.description: Puzzles, decisions and a campfire at every camp, with a very good dog as your guide. Free, in nine languages.
